claims.evidence: scenes.json sc_floor_end_shock action: hauler 2 crosses a cell of the LIVE segment at least two cells from its end (asserted on the drawn cord, not the end cell); expect: hauler 2 not shocked; control rules_out names whole-cord shock. tree.json floor_end_shocks_crossers oracle_proposed: none on the hauler crossing a live cord cell at least two cells from the end

All five rulings tested, none cut. (a) sc_floor_end_shock start adds a run the player stopped laying (live Terminal end, no destroy event), hauler 4 crosses it, expect shocked, control silent under Only downed lines. (b) constructor A delivers steel then builds, path asserted across the live end on both legs, expect not shocked on either. (c) sc_fuel_ignition adds a chemfuel puddle on a cut floor cord's live end, expect no fire; tree.json live_wire_lights_fuel oracle, experience and false_pass. (d) sc_floor_end_shock sets maxSparkingEnds 1 with two live ends asserted, one outside the spark set, expect both haulers shocked. (e) sc_shock_reach start adds a FlowWorks collapsed-deck power cord registered through the external live-wire source; expect shocked under All and Only downed lines, not under None. Ruling (6) now has one meaning in record.json d_shock_reach_agent_detail and sheet.md delegated: shock follows the live state at the last poll, never the spark budget (which caps only drawn sparks, RM_MapComponent_CordGraph.cs SparkEnds); 'only if drawn live' removed. Oracle lines in tree.json floor_end_shocks_crossers and shock_reach_setting.

scenes.json sc_no_sharp_turn action runs the sc_cords_slack read on the same strands in each look; expect requires drawn length at least 1.4 times chord on every edge and an off-line excursion of a cell or more on edges over four cells, so taut cords fail. tree.json no_unforced_sharp_turn oracle_proposed adds the same read

scenes.json sc_owner_change start adds a fourth mast of ours spanned to the first and not to the middle mast; expect with the switch on: that span stays linked and the fourth mast powered while the two spans to the claimed mast are cut (cut count two). tree.json owner_change_coils_wires scenario, oracle_proposed and a new false_pass (cut-everything sweep)

scenes.json sc_statics_new_game reads SectionLayer_RM_MessyCords.PrintedStatic (section keys, strand names) and RM_LiveWirePathCost by map id beside the tap registry and style picks (both cleared in GssSessionReset.cs); game 1 has a live fallen wire so the path-cost table is filled; expect all four empty at the start of the new game and the loaded tap-free game, the new game's floor run prints; control shows them refilled on the game-1 reload. tree.json statics_clear_between_games oracle_proposed, experience, scenario, false_pass; record.json game_statics_reset 'what' names both statics

reasons: All five claimed fixes hold at the places their evidence names. g1: sc_floor_end_shock hauler 2 crosses a live-segment cell two or more from the end, expected unshocked, and the control names whole-cord shock. g2: (a) through (e) each have an asserted start, an expect and an oracle line, and ruling 6 reads one way in record.json and sheet.md. The spark-budget criterion can be met: SparkEnds (RM_MapComponent_CordGraph.cs:592) only feeds spark drawing. g3: sc_no_sharp_turn's expect carries the sc_cords_slack 1.4x-chord and excursion criterion, so taut cords fail. g4: a fourth same-owner mast's span must survive, with the cut count fixed at two. g5: PrintedStatic and RM_LiveWirePathCost are read across the new-game and load paths, with a filled-state control. Both are cleared in GssSessionReset.cs:19 and :26. Changed entries open nothing. sc_cords_under_items is a script-staged acceptance scene: its entry point exists (validation.py:2308), it reads all five 'what' clauses, its planted-reading control (selftest exists) rules out co-presence and absence, and it is in coverage_rest. The mod_settings, settings_switch_cleanly, live_wire_lights_fuel, owner_change and statics leaves agree with their scenes. One soft point, not a gap: sc_owner_change does not say which mast the power source sits on. Its expect ('middle mast unpowered by our net', 'fourth mast powered') implies the source is on mast 1 or 4, and the script should assert that.
